face_danger.name: Face Danger
face_danger.trigger:
When you attempt something risky or react to an imminent threat, envision your action and roll. If you act...
- With speed, agility, or precision: Roll +edge.
- With charm, loyalty, or courage: Roll +heart.
- With aggressive action, forceful defense, strength, or endurance: Roll +iron.
- With deception, stealth, or trickery: Roll +shadow.
- With expertise, insight, or observation: Roll +wits.
face_danger.weak_hit: You succeed, but face a troublesome cost. Choose one.
face_danger.miss: You fail, or your progress is undermined by a dramatic and costly turn of events. Pay the Price.

options.lose_momentum: You are delayed, lose advantage, or face a new danger: Suffer -1 momentum.
options.endure_harm: You are tired or hurt: Endure Harm (1 harm).
options.endure_stress: You are dispirited or afraid: Endure Stress (1 stress).

secure_an_advantage.name: Secure an Advantage
secure_an_advantage.trigger:
When you assess a situation, make preparations, or attempt to gain leverage, envision your action and roll. If you act...
- With speed, agility, or precision: Roll +edge.
- With charm, loyalty, or courage: Roll +heart.
- With aggressive action, forceful defense, strength, or endurance: Roll +iron.
- With deception, stealth, or trickery: Roll +shadow.
- With expertise, insight, or observation: Roll +wits.
secure_an_advantage.weak_hit: Your advantage is short-lived. Take +1 momentum.
secure_an_advantage.miss: You fail or your assumptions betray you. Pay the Price.

options.take_control: Take control: Make another move now (not a progress move); when you do, add +1.

gather_information.name: Gather Information
gather_information.trigger: When you search an area, ask questions, conduct an investigation, or follow a track, roll +wits.
gather_information.strong_hit: You discover something helpful and specific. The path you must follow or action you must take to make progress is made clear. Envision what you learn (Ask the Oracle if unsure), and take +2 momentum.
gather_information.weak_hit: The information complicates your quest or introduces a new danger. Envision what you discover (Ask the Oracle if unsure), and take +1 momentum.
gather_information.miss: Your investigation unearths a dire threat or reveals an unwelcome truth that undermines your quest. Pay the Price.

bonuses.community_or_bond: You act within a community or ask questions of a person with whom you share a bond: add +1.

heal.name: Heal
heal.trigger: When you treat an injury or ailment, roll +wits. If you are mending your own wounds, roll +wits or +iron, whichever is lower.
heal.strong_hit: Your care is helpful. If you (or the ally under your care) have the wounded condition, you may clear it. Then take or give up to +2 health.
heal.weak_hit: As above, but you must suffer -1 supply or -1 momentum (your choice).
heal.miss: Your aid is ineffective. Pay the Price.

resupply.name: Resupply
resupply.trigger: When you hunt, forage, or scavenge, roll +wits. You can't do this while unprepared.
resupply.strong_hit: You bolster your resources. Take +2 supply.
resupply.weak_hit: Take up to +2 supply, but suffer -1 momentum for each.
resupply.miss: You find nothing helpful. Pay the Price.

make_camp.name: Make Camp
make_camp.trigger: When you rest and recover for several hours in the wild, roll +supply.
make_camp.strong_hit: You and your allies may each choose two.
make_camp.miss: You take no comfort. Pay the Price.

options.recuperate: Recuperate: Take +1 health for you and any companions.
options.partake: Partake: Suffer -1 supply and take +1 health for you and any companions.
options.prepare: Prepare: When you break camp, add +1 if you Undertake a Journey.

undertake_a_journey.name: Undertake a Journey
undertake_a_journey.trigger: When you travel across hazardous or unfamiliar lands, first set the rank of your journey. Then, for each segment of your journey, roll +wits.
undertake_a_journey.strong_hit: You reach a waypoint. If the waypoint is unknown to you, envision it (Ask the Oracle if unsure). Then, choose one.
undertake_a_journey.weak_hit: You reach a waypoint and mark progress, but suffer -1 supply.
undertake_a_journey.miss: You are waylaid by a perilous event. Pay the Price.

options.use_resources: You make good use of your resources: Mark progress.
options.move_at_speed: You move at speed: Mark progress and take +1 momentum, but suffer -1 supply.

bonuses.bonded_community: You are setting off from a community with which you share a bond: add +1 to your initial roll.

reach_your_destination.name: Reach Your Destination
reach_your_destination.trigger: When your journey comes to an end, roll the challenge dice and compare to your progress. Momentum is ignored on this roll.
reach_your_destination.strong_hit: The situation at your destination favors you. Choose one.
reach_your_destination.weak_hit: You arrive but face an unforeseen hazard or complication. Envision what you find (Ask the Oracle if unsure).
reach_your_destination.miss: You have gone hopelessly astray, your objective is lost to you, or you were misled about your destination.

options.make_another_move: Make another move now (not a progress move), and add +1.
options.journey_continues: Your journey continues: clear all but one filled progress, and raise the journey's rank by one (if not already epic).

swear_an_iron_vow.name: Swear an Iron Vow
swear_an_iron_vow.trigger: When you swear upon iron to complete a quest, write your vow and give the quest a rank. Then, roll +heart.
swear_an_iron_vow.strong_hit: You are emboldened and it is clear what you must do next (Ask the Oracle if unsure). Take +2 momentum.
swear_an_iron_vow.weak_hit: You are determined but begin your quest with more questions than answers. Take +1 momentum, and envision what you do to find a path forward.
swear_an_iron_vow.miss: You face a significant obstacle before you can begin your quest. Envision what stands in your way (Ask the Oracle if unsure), and choose one.

options.press_on: You press on: Suffer -2 momentum, and do what you must to overcome this obstacle.
options.give_up: You give up: Forsake Your Vow.

bonuses.sworn_to_bond: You make this vow to a person or community with whom you share a bond: add +1.

reach_a_milestone.name: Reach a Milestone
reach_a_milestone.trigger:
When you make significant progress in your quest by overcoming a critical obstacle, completing a perilous journey, solving a complex mystery, defeating a powerful threat, gaining vital support, or acquiring a crucial item, you may mark progress.
- Troublesome quest: Mark 3 progress.
- Dangerous quest: Mark 2 progress.
- Formidable quest: Mark 1 progress.
- Extreme quest: Mark 2 ticks.
- Epic quest: Mark 1 tick.

fulfill_your_vow.name: Fulfill Your Vow
fulfill_your_vow.trigger: When you achieve what you believe to be the fulfillment of your vow, roll the challenge dice and compare to your progress. Momentum is ignored on this roll.
fulfill_your_vow.strong_hit: Your quest is complete. Mark experience (troublesome=1; dangerous=2; formidable=3; extreme=4; epic=5).
fulfill_your_vow.weak_hit: There is more to be done or you realize the truth of your quest. Envision what you discover (Ask the Oracle if unsure). Then, mark experience (troublesome=0; dangerous=1; formidable=2; extreme=3; epic=4). You may Swear an Iron Vow to set things right. If you do, add +1.
fulfill_your_vow.miss: Your quest is undone. Envision what happens (Ask the Oracle if unsure), and choose one.

options.recommit: You recommit: Clear all but one filled progress, and raise the quest's rank by one (if not already epic).
options.give_up: You give up: Forsake Your Vow.

forsake_your_vow.name: Forsake Your Vow
forsake_your_vow.trigger: When you renounce your quest, betray your promise, or the goal is lost to you, clear the vow and Endure Stress. You suffer -spirit equal to the rank of your quest (troublesome=1; dangerous=2; formidable=3; extreme=4; epic=5).

advance.name: Advance
advance.trigger: When you focus on your skills, receive training, find inspiration, earn a reward, or gain a companion, you may spend 3 experience to add a new asset, or 2 experience to upgrade an asset.

options.new_asset: Spend 3 experience to add a new asset.
options.upgrade_asset: Spend 2 experience to upgrade an asset.
